_comment: Source layout for the RLM_QuantumBit_Deck PowerPoint template. Build with: python scripts/docgen/docgen_template_build.py create scripts/docgen/layouts/quantumbit-sales-deck.layout.json -o out.pptx. Served by the same RLMQuoteExtractBasic + RLMQuoteTransformBasic pair as the Word proposal. Deliberately avoids whole-slide conditional gating: DocGen removes gated content but cannot delete a slide, so a false gate would leave a blank slide in the deck. Amendment detail therefore stays in the Word proposal, and every slide here renders for any quote.
